acceptance.evidence: Both existing methods have setup labels and explicit required nonsecret environment/realm fields. Environment is sandbox or production without a default. Numeric realm schema remains a string of 1–32 digits. Existing method and protocol choices are unchanged.

Catalog binds the provider-local probe to the existing public CompanyInfo action. It reuses schema validation, fixed endpoints, response validation, credential-echo rejection, retry bounds, injected HTTP and rate limiter. No token acquisition, refresh, storage or scope policy is introduced.

Probe returns optional company display name, provider company_id and explicitly configured realm/environment context. provider_account_id remains null. No scope or grant evidence is inferred from read success; CompanyInfo.Id is not treated as realm attestation.

Probe exposes only fixed messages, an allowlisted reason and bounded integer status. Shared probe boundary sanitizes again. Focused tests cover malformed/duplicate response fields, credential echoes, provider 401/403/429/503 and unsafe exception details.

Exactly two QuickBooks actions and their schemas/config remain unchanged. Existing actions.py, integration.py and response.py are byte-identical, retaining invoice precision. Google Indexing/GSC and shared auth source have no diff from accepted 0.2.3.

Frozen commit is clean. Stored patch equals exact git diff. Every evidence-manifest hash matches. All 437 packaged source files match both frozen source and installed wheel environment; CRC is valid. Installed smoke confirms version 0.2.4, package origins and blocked live sockets.
